answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a sparrow as the anchor of the cost. A river stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a timber...
